subject.title: feat(discord/voice): add sessionChannelId to autoJoin for text-channel transcript routing

question: Should Discord voice text mirroring use a new per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId` field, extend the existing `voice.agentSession` target model, or remain deferred until the broader voice-as-I/O design is reopened?
rationale: Current main has partial session routing but not visible text delivery, and the proposed config/delivery behavior affects Discord voice session semantics and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Extend agentSession
options.body: Prefer the existing `voice.agentSession` route as the canonical target model and add visible transcript/reply delivery there only if it avoids a parallel config source of truth.

options.title: Adopt per-autoJoin mapping
options.body: Accept the narrower `sessionChannelId` shape if maintainers want each fixed auto-join room to own its companion text channel directly.

options.title: Defer bridge delivery
options.body: Keep current session routing only and pause visible transcript/reply mirroring until the broader voice-as-I/O design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Extend agentSession
recommendation.body: Prefer the existing `voice.agentSession` route as the canonical target model and add visible transcript/reply delivery there only if it avoids a parallel config source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current Discord voice route/schema surface and have already reviewed this exact product boundary in the issue discussion.
